@comment: Preflight from an ALLOWLISTED origin. corsPreflightMiddleware (routes.go) runs before routing and answers 204 with the Origin ECHOED — never '*' — alongside credentials:true, so a shared cache can never serve one origin's grant to another. http://localhost:3000 is a baked-in dev origin in newCORSOriginAllower, the ONE allowlist this gateway has. Allow-Headers is the ask echoed back name for name (corsAllowHeaders), not a literal list — so it is exactly the Access-Control-Request-Headers above, and Vary names that header too, because the answer now depends on it.

Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS
